qa_concat_macro.name: qa_concat_macro
qa_concat_macro.definition:
concat(
  TRIM('{{input_string}}', '?-'), 
  REPLACE('{{input_string}}', 'bc'), 
  RIGHT('{{input_string}}', 3), 
  CAST(HASH(SEQ8()) AS string), 
  ASCII('A'), 
  REPEAT('xy', 5), 
  REVERSE('Hello, world!'), 
  SUBSTR('testing 1 2 3', 9, 5), 
  INSERT('abc', 1, 2, 'Z'), 
  RTRIM('$125.00', '0.'), 
  UUID_STRING(), 
  sha1('{{input_string}}'), 
  CAST(md5_binary('{{input_string}}') AS string), 
  LPAD(' hello ', 10, ' '), 
  DECOMPRESS_STRING(TO_BINARY('0920536E6F77666C616B65', 'HEX'), 'SNAPPY'), 
  LPAD('.  hi. ', 10, '$'), 
  DAYNAME(TO_DATE('2015-05-01')), 
  CAST(LAST_DAY(TO_DATE('2015-05-08T23:39:20.123-07:00')) AS string), 
  CAST(DATEADD(YEAR, 2, TO_DATE('2013-05-08')) AS string), 
  CAST(DATEDIFF(MONTH, '2021-01-01'::DATE, '2021-02-28'::DATE) AS string), 
  CAST(DATEDIFF(
    HOUR, 
    '2013-05-08T23:39:20.123-07:00'::TIMESTAMP, 
    DATEADD(YEAR, 2, ('2013-05-08T23:39:20.123-07:00')::TIMESTAMP)) AS string), 
  CAST(TIMEDIFF(YEAR, '2017-01-01', '2019-01-01') AS string), 
  CAST(TIME_SLICE('2019-02-28'::DATE, 4, 'MONTH', 'START') AS string), 
  CAST(TRY_TO_TIME('12:30:00') AS string))

qa_boolean_macro_test.name: qa_boolean_macro_test
qa_boolean_macro_test.definition:
startswith('sasd', 'te')
or REGEXP_LIKE({{input_column}}, 'san.*')
or RLIKE({{input_column}}, 'san.*', 'i')
or CONTAINS({{input_column}}, 'te')
or ({{input_column}} LIKE '%j%h%do%')
